questions.passage: Simply giving employees a sense of agency ― a feeling that they are in control, that they have genuine __________ ― can radically increase how much energy and focus they bring to their jobs. One 2010 study at a manufacturing plant in Ohio, for instance, carefully examined assembly-line workers who were empowered to make small decisions about their schedules and work environment. They designed their own uniforms and had authority over shifts while all the manufacturing processes and pay scales stayed the same. Within two months, productivity at the plant increased by 20 percent, with workers taking shorter breaks and making fewer mistakes. Giving employees a sense of control improved how much self-discipline they brought to their jobs.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: decision-making authority=의사 결정 권한 — 주인의식의 핵심 요소
det.analysis:
❌ ① physical strength(신체적 힘): 주인의식과 무관
❌ ② financial reward(금전적 보상): 본문은 급여가 그대로였다고 함 — 반대
✅ ③ decision-making authority: 원문 일치. 'a feeling ... that they have genuine ______'에서 주인의식은 진정한 의사 결정 권한을 갖는 느낌 ←정답
❌ ④ job security(고용 안정): 본문과 무관
det.tip: genuine decision-making authority = 진정한 의사 결정 권한

questions.passage: Simply giving employees a sense of agency ― a feeling that they are in control, that they have genuine decision-making authority ― can radically increase how much energy and focus they bring to their jobs. One 2010 study at a manufacturing plant in Ohio, for instance, carefully examined assembly-line workers who were empowered to make small decisions about their schedules and work environment. They designed their own uniforms and had authority over shifts while all the manufacturing processes and pay scales stayed the same. Within two months, productivity at the plant increased by 20 percent, with workers taking shorter breaks and making fewer mistakes. Giving employees a sense of control improved how much __________ they brought to their jobs.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① free time(자유 시간): 본문이 말하는 향상 대상이 아님
❌ ② vacation days(휴가 일수): 본문과 무관
❌ ③ physical energy(신체적 에너지): 유사하나 원문은 자기 통제력을 지칭
✅ ④ self-discipline: 원문 일치. 'Giving employees a sense of control improved how much ______ they brought to their jobs'에서 통제감이 자기 통제력(self-discipline)을 향상시킴 ←정답
det.tip: improved how much self-discipline they brought = 자기 통제력을 향상
